Welcome to Grövelsjön | Visit Dalarna For full functionality of this site it is necessary to enable JavaScript. Here are the instructions how to enable JavaScript in your web browser Copyright Photo: Anna Holm Copyright Photo: Alexander Neimert Welcome to Grövelsjön Grövelsjön is Dalarna's northernmost mountain world. Here, on the border with Norway, a nature experience out of the ordinary awaits. Follow scenic mountain trails that stretch out into a wilderness right outside the door. See reindeer roam freely and experience Sámi culture up close. STF Grövelsjön Mountain Station sits 816 metres above sea level and is an excellent base for hiking and cross-country skiing. The area also offers quota-regulated fly fishing in the Storån river – one of Dalarna's most sought-after fishing waters. Sights Explore the most fascinating sights of Grövelsjön — from stunning mountain landscapes to rich Sámi culture. Explore Grövelsjön here Copyright Photo: Johan Persson Fly fish in quota-regulated area Fish in the quota-regulated fly fishing area of Storån river. Here you can book accommodation and fishing permits. Book here Events Grövelsjön offers a wide range of events that attract both visitors and locals. See upcoming events in Grövelsjön Copyright Photo: Hilla Aspman Offers Book a package offer for a holiday trip to Grövelsjön. Länsstyrelsen Dalarna Fly fishing license in Storån Facility: 
  Länsstyrelsen Dalarna Book a fishing license for the quoted fly fishing area in Storån, Grövelsjön. Grövelsjön From price: 1.050 SEK /person Book Länsstyrelsen Dalarna Fishing license + cottage in Storån Facility: 
  Länsstyrelsen Dalarna Book both fly fishing licenses and one of the cottages at Särsjön on the quoted fly fishing area in Storån, Grövelsjön. Grövelsjön From price: 3.150 SEK /person Book More offers More about Grövelsjön Grövelsjön has a lot to offer. Discover everything from accommodation and activities to food and drink and more.
